result_text:
The contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer cut off at `contributorsListLimit`. The reports module compiles and its tests pass (`mvn -q -o -pl reports test` ran with no failures). I didn't add a test for the untruncated output.

- **`reports/.../statichtml/LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `limit(...)` from the table rows in `saveContributorsTable`, and removed the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. Ordering is unchanged. This covers `contributors.html`, `contributors-recent.html`, `bots.html` and the teams pages, since they all go through this method.
- **`reports/.../statichtml/ContributorListsSection.java`**: removed the `limit(...)` from `getBarsHtml`, so the bar chart draws one bar per recently active contributor.

`contributorsListLimit` is still in `LandscapeConfiguration`, as you asked. Nothing reads it now, so it has no effect. You may want to remove it or mark it deprecated in a follow-up. Nothing is committed.
